name: Contract Intake Review
description: A new contract is checked before it is filed. The requester picks the reviewer (Choose Users, one user, into a user variable), then a Review Data task asks for the document type (required), the party and the dates, with the result in an XML variable; a Logger line names the reviewer.

steps.name: Pick the reviewer
steps.instructions: Pick who reviews this contract's data, then complete the task.
steps.subject: Pick a reviewer

steps.name: Review the contract data
steps.instructions: Check the document type, party and dates; fix any that are wrong, then complete the review.
steps.subject: Review the contract data
